content:
anita: starting a staged rollout for api v2 -> gateway (canary 10%). tagging @ops-oncall @liam @josh — I see a small uptick in 4xx from mobile canary, can we triage?

liam: on it. any error examples?

maya: sample from logs: `400 Bad Request - {\"error\":\"unknown header: X-Client-Feature\"}` coming from gateway-proxy-02. spike started ~2m after canary shift.

josh: quick theory — new routing path introduced a header whitelist that was inadvertently case-sensitive. mobile sdk sends `x-client-feature` lowercase. gateway should treat headers case-insensitively.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: v2.2.0 -> gateway (canary 10%) by anita

anita: ok. can we hotfix or do we pin clients back to v1? we should avoid user impact.

liam: I have a one-line config fix to normalize headers in the new proxy path. patch: `normalize_headers: true` — I can apply to canary config and redeploy the canary nodes. estimated ~15m including health checks.

josh: that sounds right. if we can't get the fix in quickly, we should pin affected tenants to v1 as a temporary fallback. list of tenants with >1% error: mobile-android-prod, mobile-ios-prod.

maya: ops-oncall, can you monitor the three metrics please: `gateway_4xx_rate`, `mobile_sdk_errors`, `v2_p50_latency`? set alert threshold to 0.5% above baseline for the next 30m.

ops-oncall: ack. alert windows set. I'll watch dashboards and sample request traces.

anita: decision: liam -> push normalization to canary now. if error rate doesn't drop within 10m, we pin those tenants to v1 and roll back canary. josh -> prep release notes blurb so PMs are informed.

liam: applying change to canary config now:
```
# gateway canary config (delta)
route: api-v2
normalize_headers: true
header_whitelist: ["x-client-version","x-client-feature","authorization"]
```
Deploying patch to canary nodes...

deploy-bot: Deploy job queued: apply-config v2-gateway-canary -> job id 48721

ops-oncall: seeing initial reduction in 4xx within 3m, traces show header normalized on new path. continuing to monitor.

maya: good sign. what's the rollback command if it regresses?

josh: `/deploy rollback 3790000000 --stage canary` (this will revert the gateway canary config and pause automated promotion). also we can `pin-tenant mobile-android-prod v1` for immediate mitigation.

liam: canary nodes healthy, 4xx rate back to baseline ±0.02%. recommending promote to 20% and keep normalization flag for all v2 routes.

anita: promote to 20% now, ops continue 5m windows. josh, add a short note to the release notes: "Gateway now normalizes header case for v2 routing; older sdk clients unaffected."

deploy-bot: Rollout progressed: canary -> 20% (job id 48721)

ops-oncall: monitoring steady. no new alerts. mobile_ android errors at baseline.

josh: release-notes draft added to GH: `docs/release_notes/v2-2026-03.md` — mention header normalization + compatibility note for custom proxies.

anita: thanks team. decision: keep normalization in v2 config permanently, no tenant pins required. leaving automated rollback hooks in place for 60m window.

deploy-bot: Rollout completed to 100% (v2.2.0) — health checks green. Can reopen if issues.

liam: closing ops loop. I'll open a small postmortem ticket to track the config lint that allowed a case-sensitive whitelist.

maya: noted. ops-oncall -> will archive the alert policy used and attach traces.

anita: excellent — final action items: josh update release notes public copy, liam open postmortem PR, maya attach traces and alert config, ops verify no residual customer impact.

ops-oncall: all set, closing watch. :thumbsup:
